A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same EchoONE research and provide readable text, figures, tables, equations and references across all 10 pages. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original internal and external segmentation experiments, qualitative results and component ablations in Sections 4.3–4.4, Tables 2–5 and Figures 6–8.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original segmentation experiments and ablation results in Sections 4.3–4.4, Tables 2–5 and Figures 6–8.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same SAM architecture, PC-Mask prompt generation, CNN branch, LFFA fusion and training objectives. The corrected encoder label in Figure 2 does not change the method.

E1.justification: Both use CAMUS and private datasets A–D internally, with HMC_QU and EchoNet-Dynamic for external evaluation. Coverage of 2CH, 3CH, 4CH and pooled PSAX views is unchanged.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain U-Net, DeepLabV3+, SwinUNet, H2Former, SAM, MedSAM, SAMed, SAM-Med2D, MSA and SAMUS. No comparator is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain the same subject-level 80/10/10 split, external evaluation procedure, Dice/IoU/HD95 metrics, 256×256 inputs, ViT-B backbone and 100-epoch training budget.

E4.justification: Table 5 retains the same four combinations testing PC-Mask and LFFA. The analyses across planes, structures and datasets, and the qualitative examples in Figure 8, are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version provides repeated-run counts, seed values, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings and qualitative segmentation examples are unchanged. For example, Table 4 reports EchoONE mDice of 73.94 on HMC_QU and 88.36 on EchoNet-Dynamic in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and formulations in Section 3, including Equations 1–6, are identical. Neither version contains additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about unified multi-plane segmentation, PC-Mask, LFFA, annotation unification and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: Both retain the same explanations linking PC-Mask to PSAX performance and LFFA to boundary refinement. The conclusion retains the qualification that validation covers ultrasound only and the same claimed applicability to other medical modalities.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures, including initialization, augmentation, optimizer settings, PyTorch and A6000 hardware, are identical. Both retain the same future code-release statement and repository link.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 43 references are unchanged, including the positioning of EchoONE relative to multi-branch segmentation and existing SAM adaptation and prompting methods.

P1.justification: v2 corrects 'Eecoder Transformer Block' to 'Encoder Transformer Block' in Figure 2 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The body prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 receives the encoder-label spelling correction. Its architecture drawing is otherwise unchanged, as are all other figures, tables, captions and page arrangements.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects one spelling error in Figure 2 and updates the version stamp. This cosmetic refinement leaves the scientific content, evidence, explanations and reproducibility information unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
